sprints.name: Sprint 1 — Foundation & First Paper Trade
sprints.goal: Deliver a working bot skeleton that can fetch market data, run SMA strategy, enforce basic policy, and place paper trades.
features: Alpaca market data + paper trading integration
sprints.validation: Bot runs on Alpaca sandbox for 1 day; logs show SMA signals, policy check, and executed trades.
sprints.progress: Dev environment ready and Alpaca helpers stubbed; strategy/policy/logging work outstanding.

sprints.name: Sprint 2 — Backtesting & Risk Enhancements
sprints.goal: Introduce backtesting framework and expand risk controls.
features: Backtest module with CSV/SQLite OHLCV store
Policy engine with position limits & daily loss cap
Audit log integrated into backtest results
sprints.validation: Run SMA strategy on historical AAPL/TSLA data; verify signals, orders, PnL and logs are consistent.
sprints.progress: Blocked on Sprint 1 delivering core trading loop.

sprints.name: Sprint 3 — Observability & Configurable Strategies
sprints.goal: Deliver full MVP with observability, configurable policies, and deployment automation.
features: Trade history & PnL dashboard (CLI or web UI)
sprints.validation: Deploy bot for 1-week Alpaca sandbox run; backtest vs. live results compared; dashboard/report generated.
sprints.progress: Depends on earlier sprints for policy/backtest foundations.
